$comment: Task-branch model: implementers commit and push their own task/* branch and lease-push it after a rebase; nobody but the main session commits on main or master, though any subagent may pull, merge or rebase there to integrate it (git.integrate); a task branch is deleted only after GitHub shows its PR merged; the project keeps its own git hooks under tools/git-hooks. One usage line at 75% that the owner's override may lift, on either meter, up to and past saturation; no stop line.

usage.holdAdvice: No new implementers. Finish work already in flight; a verifier for an already-launched task needs the owner's override. Otherwise wait for the reset or the owner's word.
